native_mechanisms: Each mark poured into the never-pure cup, the cup's changed colour seeding the next pour — one serial, order-dependent accumulator over the whole pile, no byte judged alone or twice.
The cup's final colour carried through seven organs in turn, each bending it and discarding half of what it received, passing on only what refuses to sit still.
Flip one mark anywhere in the pile, re-pour from the first cup, and condemn the whole method if the new token still resembles the old one's shape (avalanche as a rejection test).
core_technique: FNV-1a byte-wise xor-multiply accumulation (8x unrolled, serial dependency chain) followed by the MurmurHash3 fmix64 finalizer.
